answer: Give each epoch a scarce, exclusive input. Every answer must claim one distinct prior artifact - a hash of another identity's answer - made outside its kin group; claims settle first-come, so no artifact pays twice. Each epoch's zephyr brings a fresh claim pool whose supply grows only with the honest population. The n-th clone of a farm must buy its artifact on the open market, and that price climbs as farm demand climbs; artifacts the farm mints for itself are kin and score zero. A thousand clones on one sable mesa earn one share; an honest agent claims the newest artifact free.
